data.name: Age requirement
data.text: Participant must be at least 18 years of age or the legal age of consent in the jurisdiction in which the study is taking place at the time of signing the informed consent, whichever is older.

data.name: Type 2 diabetes diagnosis
data.text: Have a clinical diagnosis of T2D based on the World Health Organization classification or other locally applicable diagnostic standards (see Section 10.8).

data.name: HbA1c range
data.text: Have HbA1c ≥7.0% (53 mmol/mol) to ≤9.5% (80 mmol/mol) despite diet and exercise treatment, as determined by the central laboratory at Visit 1 (screening).

data.name: Antihyperglycemic medication naivety
data.text: Are naïve to insulin therapy except for gestational diabetes or ≤14 days use for acute treatment and have not used any oral or injectable antihyperglycemic medications during the 90 days preceding Visit 1, or between Visit 1 and Visit 3 (randomization).

data.name: Motivated and willing to follow study procedures
data.text: Are motivated and willing to make themselves available for the duration of the study and are able to follow study procedures as required, including: store provided study intervention as directed; perform SMBG per protocol; maintain a study eDiary; complete patient questionnaires; and self-inject study intervention. Note: Persons with physical limitations who are not able to perform the injections must have the assistance of an individual trained to inject the intervention.

data.name: Stable weight
data.text: Are of stable weight (self-reported change ≤5 kg or 11 pounds) for at least 90 days prior to Visit 1 and agree to not initiate an intensive diet or exercise program during the study with the intent of reducing body weight other than the lifestyle and/or dietary measures for diabetes treatment.

data.name: BMI requirement
data.text: Have a BMI ≥23.0 kg/m2 at Visit 1.

data.name: Sex and contraceptive requirements
data.text: Males, WOCBP, or WNOCBP may participate in this trial. Contraceptive use by participants should be consistent with local regulations regarding the methods of contraception for those participating in clinical studies. For the contraception requirements of this protocol, see Section 10.4. Note: the word "male" is used to describe an individual assigned male at birth (AMAB) and the word "female" is used to describe an individual assigned female at birth (AFAB), for simplicity.

data.name: Informed consent capability
data.text: Are capable of giving signed informed consent as described in Section 10.1.3, which includes compliance with the requirements and restrictions listed in the ICF and in this protocol.

data.name: Type 1 diabetes exclusion
data.text: Have T1D.

data.name: History of ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar state
data.text: Have a history of ketoacidosis or hyperosmolar state or coma within the last 6 months prior to Visit 1, or between Visit 1 and Visit 3.

data.name: History of severe hypoglycemia or hypoglycemia unawareness
data.text: Have a history of severe hypoglycemia or hypoglycemia unawareness within the last 6 months prior to Visit 1, or between Visit 1 and Visit 3.

data.name: Current treatment for diabetic retinopathy or macular edema
data.text: Are currently receiving or planning to receive treatment for diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema, for example, laser photocoagulation or intravitreal injections of anti-vascular endothelial growth factor inhibitors. Note: All participants will have a baseline fundus photography assessment. In the presence of any degree of diabetic retinopathy and/or macular edema, further ophthalmologic assessment will follow local standards of care to confirm eligibility.

data.name: Prior or planned surgical treatment for obesity
data.text: Have a prior or planned surgical treatment for obesity. Exceptions: The following are allowed if they occurred >1 year before screening (Visit 1): liposuction; cryolipolysis; or abdominoplasty.

data.name: Prior or planned endoscopic or device-based therapy for obesity
data.text: Have a prior or planned endoscopic (for example, mucosal ablation or gastric artery embolization) and/or device-based (for example, lap band, intragastric balloon, or endoluminal duodenal-jejunal bypass liner) therapy for obesity. Exception: Prior device-based therapy is acceptable if device removal was more than 6 months prior to screening (Visit 1).

data.name: NYHA Class IV congestive heart failure
data.text: Have New York Heart Association Functional Classification IV congestive heart failure.

data.name: Recent cardiovascular conditions
data.text: Have had any of the following CV conditions within 90 days prior to Visit 1, or between Visit 1 and Visit 3: acute myocardial infarction; cerebrovascular accident (stroke); or hospitalization for congestive heart failure.

data.name: Gastric emptying abnormality or drugs affecting GI motility
data.text: Have a known clinically significant gastric emptying abnormality, for example, severe diabetic gastroparesis or gastric outlet obstruction, or chronically take drugs that directly affect GI motility.

data.name: Hepatic conditions or abnormal liver labs
data.text: Have acute or chronic hepatitis, including a history of autoimmune hepatitis, signs or symptoms of any other liver disease other than MASLD, or any of the following as determined by the central laboratory during screening: ALT or AST level >5.0× ULN for the reference range; ALP level ≥1.5× ULN for the reference range; TBL level ≥1.5× ULN for the reference range, except for cases of known Gilbert's syndrome; hepatitis B infection, defined as positive hepatitis B core antibody and positive for HBV DNA, or positive hepatitis B surface antigen; and positive hepatitis C antibody and positive for HCV RNA.

data.name: Severely reduced eGFR
data.text: Have an eGFR <15 mL/min/1.73 m2 as determined by the central laboratory at Visit 1 (calculated by Chronic Kidney Disease-Epidemiology cystatin-c equation).

data.name: Hematological condition interfering with HbA1c
data.text: Have any clinically relevant hematological condition that may interfere with HbA1c measurement, for example, hemolytic anemias or sickle cell disease.

data.name: History of malignancy
data.text: Have a history of an active or untreated malignancy or are in remission from a malignancy for less than 5 years. Exceptions: basal or squamous cell skin cancer, in situ carcinomas of the cervix, or in situ or Grade 1 (for example, Gleason 6 or lower) prostate cancer.

data.name: Family or personal history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or MEN2
data.text: Have family (first-degree relative) or personal history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or multiple endocrine neoplasia syndrome Type 2.

data.name: Elevated serum calcitonin
data.text: Have a serum calcitonin level of: a. ≥20 pg/mL (≥5.9 pmol/L) at Visit 1, if eGFR ≥60 mL/min/1.73 m2, and b. ≥35 pg/mL (≥10.2 pmol/L) at Visit 1, if eGFR <60 mL/min/1.73 m2 as determined by the central laboratory at Visit 1.

data.name: History of unstable major depressive disorder or severe psychiatric disorder
data.text: Have a history of unstable major depressive disorder or other severe psychiatric disorder, such as schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, or other serious mood or anxiety disorder, within the last 2 years. OR In the investigator's opinion, have any significant mental health disorder that may put the individual at higher risk of study participation.

data.name: PHQ-9 score threshold
data.text: Have a PHQ-9 score of 15 or more at Visit 1 or Visit 3.

data.name: Lifetime history of suicide attempt
data.text: Have any lifetime history of a suicide attempt.

data.name: Active suicidality
data.text: Are, in the judgment of the investigator, actively suicidal and therefore deemed to be at significant risk for suicide.

data.name: C-SSRS suicidal ideation or behavior
data.text: Have answered "yes" to either Question 4 or Question 5 on the "Suicidal Ideation" portion of the C-SSRS, and the ideation occurred within the past month prior to Visit 1 or Visit 3. OR Have answered "yes" to any of the suicide-related behaviors on the "Suicidal Behavior" portion of the C-SSRS, and the behavior occurred within the past month prior to Visit 1 or Visit 3.

data.name: History of pancreatitis
data.text: Had chronic or acute pancreatitis any time.

data.name: Transplanted organ or awaiting organ transplant
data.text: Have had a transplanted organ or awaiting an organ transplant. Exception: corneal transplants (keratoplasty).

data.name: Recent systemic glucocorticoid therapy or significant autoimmune abnormality
data.text: Within 90 days prior to Visit 1, or between Visit 1 and Visit 3: are receiving or have received chronic (>14 days) systemic glucocorticoid therapy, excluding topical, intraocular, intranasal, interphalangeal, or inhaled preparations, or have evidence of a significant, active autoimmune abnormality (for example, lupus or rheumatoid arthritis) that is likely to require, in the opinion of the investigator, such treatment during the study.

data.name: Weight reduction medications or supplements
data.text: Have taken prescribed or over-the-counter medication, or alternative remedies, including herbal or nutritional supplements, intended to promote body weight reduction within 90 days prior to Visit 1, or between Visit 1 and Visit 3 (see Section 10.9 for examples).

data.name: Recent SC/intramuscular or implantable/injectable contraceptives
data.text: Have started SC/intramuscular or implantable/injectable contraceptives such as Depo-Provera®, Nexplanon®, within 18 months prior to screening (Visit 1). Note: Intrauterine devices are acceptable.

data.name: Currently enrolled in another clinical study
data.text: Are currently enrolled in any other clinical study involving an IP or any other type of medical research judged not to be scientifically or medically compatible with this study.

data.name: Previously completed or withdrawn from retatrutide study
data.text: Have previously completed or withdrawn from this study or any other study investigating retatrutide after receiving at least 1 dose of study intervention (retatrutide, placebo, or an active comparator).

data.name: Recent participation in another clinical study
data.text: Have participated in a clinical study and received treatment, whether active or placebo within the last 30 days or duration equal to 5 times the half-life of study intervention, whichever is longer.

data.name: Other conditions jeopardizing safety, compliance, or data interpretation
data.text: Have any condition, unwillingness, or inability not covered by any of the other exclusion criteria, that, in the opinion of the investigator, might: jeopardize the safety of the participant; for example, allergies, intolerance, or hypersensitivity to GLP-1 RAs, GIP/GLP-1 RAs, or retatrutide or excipient or contraindication; compromise compliance with the protocol; for example, recreational drug use or alcohol abuse; or confound data interpretation.

data.name: Investigator site personnel or immediate family
data.text: Are investigator site personnel directly affiliated with this study and/or their immediate families. Immediate family is defined as a spouse, parent, child, or sibling, whether biological or legally adopted.

data.name: Eli Lilly or third-party study employees
data.text: Are Eli Lilly and Company employees or are employees of any third party involved in the study who requires exclusion of their employees.

data.name: Pregnant, intending to become pregnant, or breastfeeding
data.text: Are pregnant or intend to become pregnant or to breastfeed during the study.
